name: YWCAMP@Hoboken
description_short: YWCA day camp for Hoboken residents ages 5 to 12, held at Wallace Elementary School with Hoboken Public Schools. Campers do arts and crafts, nature, theater, field games and swimming at the Hoboken High School pool, with reading and math woven into activities.
refund_policy_summary: Registration and weekly fees are not refundable; changes cost a $25 processing fee.
notes: Open only to Hoboken residents; proof of residency is required. Full day 8:30 to 5:00 is $300 a week ($270 for an additional child); short weeks $180 and $240. Pre camp 7:30 to 8:30 and post camp 5:00 to 6:30 cost extra. $35 registration fee. A half day option and the Camp Tastebuds cooking camp also run at this site. Financial help through the state's child care assistance program for income eligible families.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. YWCA summer camps page: ACA accredited camps for ages 5 to 12; YWCamp@Hoboken at Wallace Elementary School; activities listed; financial assistance for income eligible families through NJ CCAP.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 YWCamp@Hoboken application (with Hoboken Public Schools): must be a Hoboken resident; six weeks June 24 to July 31 with weekly fees; pre and post camp care; swimming at Hoboken High School pool.
